_help: Config of the autotest of ONE project. /autotest-init writes qa.config.json from this file. No secret here: passwords / tokens are read from the environment variables named below. Guide: docs/01_setup_guide.md of the autotest kit.

language._help: talk = language the agent uses with you; excel = one evidence workbook per language (vi, ja, en); testcase = language of the testcase files (when an Excel language differs, write suites/<suite>/<lang>_text.py)

browser._help: mode launch = the framework starts its own browser with a persistent profile; cdp = attach to a browser you started with --remote-debugging-port (when login needs MFA / SSO by a human). channel: chromium | msedge | chrome

auth._help: type none | form | manual. form: the framework logs in with the account below. manual: a human logs in once in the test browser (SSO / MFA); the framework only checks logged_in

matrix._help: How the role / environment column of the testcases maps to runs. key -> words that identify it in the column (first word = label in captions). A case runs once per (env, role) found; none found -> defaults. Leave envs empty when the app has one environment.

roles._help: switch none | accounts | command. accounts: one test account per role (env vars). command: a project script that changes the role of the test account, e.g. "python tools/set_role.py --role {role}"

data._help: test_prefix = every object a test creates starts with it (guard + cleanup). snapshot none | hooks | command: how the before/after integrity check reads the data (project/hooks.py snapshot(), or a command printing JSON)

testcases._help: sources = globs of the testcase workbooks (earlier = primary when an ID is in several files). columns = extra header names of your workbooks, e.g. {"exp": ["Kỳ vọng"]}

report._help: Excel output: the testcase sheet gets Result / Tester / Date filled (the source file is never written). tester = name written in the tester column (default app.test_account). result_values = your workbook's vocabulary, e.g. {"PASS": "OK", "FAIL": "NG"}; empty = taken from the column's drop-down list when it has one, else PASS / FAIL. NOT EXECUTED stays empty.

source._help: use = false: black-box mode - the agent never opens the app source (expectations from testcases + inputs/autotest_input.xlsx + docs/system_map, selectors from the live DOM); /system-test source and suite impact are refused. true = the agent may read the repos of test_suite/source_map.json.
